description: This PHP test class 'I18NTranslationBulkAPITest' performs unit and integration tests on the 'I18NTranslationBulkAPI' REST API endpoints related to bulk translation operations in the OrangeHRM system, particularly for the internationalization (I18N) features. It utilizes PHPUnit for testing, mocking, and fixtures handling.

classes.name: I18NTranslationBulkAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class extending EndpointIntegrationTestCase to perform API endpoint tests for the I18NTranslationBulkAPI related to translation bulk operations in OrangeHRM.
